tokens.name: desktop
tokens.usage: App ground behind every window, and the surround the scan workspace sits on. Kept neutral so it never tints judgement of a frame.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Window body and control face: toolbars, side panels, dialogs. Luna uses the classic XP control-face beige.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Text fields, list boxes, the properties grid, popovers: anything you type into or pick from.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells cut into a window: the film-strip tray, the histogram bed, the log console. Holds `ink`; `ink-muted` is not used here in Luna (4.48:1).

tokens.name: loupe
tokens.usage: Neutral mid-grey matte directly around the frame under inspection in the loupe. Never put text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on `desktop`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, units, frame metadata, disabled-adjacent hints. On `surface` and `surface-raised` (and `desktop`, `surface-sunken` in Darkroom).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels, list rows and group-box outlines. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: The 1px outer edge of buttons, fields, checkboxes and the progress trough. ≥3:1 on `surface-raised` in Darkroom; in Luna 4.5:1 on white fields, 3.7:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: bevel-hi
tokens.usage: Top/left highlight of a raised bevel and the gloss line on title bars and buttons.

tokens.name: bevel-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom/right shade of a raised bevel; the top/left of a sunken well.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: Active window title bar and the app header strip. Carries `on-titlebar` only.

tokens.name: titlebar-gloss
tokens.usage: Top 40% gloss band of the title bar, blended into `titlebar`. Never behind title text on its own.

tokens.name: titlebar-inactive
tokens.usage: Title bar of an unfocused window. Title text drops to `on-titlebar` at 80% only in Darkroom.

tokens.name: on-titlebar
tokens.usage: Title text and caption-button glyphs on `titlebar` (7.7:1 Darkroom, 6.0:1 Luna).

tokens.name: tab-face
tokens.usage: Unselected tab on the glossy app bar (Tabs). The selected tab takes surface and joins the panel below.

tokens.name: tab-hot
tokens.usage: The thin warm top edge of a hovered or selected tab, as on XP Luna tabs. Only on tabs.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected list row, selected frame outline fill, highlighted menu item. Text on it is `on-selection`.

tokens.name: on-selection
tokens.usage: Text on `selection` (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the focus ring, active tab underline, slider thumbs, the loupe crosshair. Meets 4.5:1 as text on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: The one primary action per window — Scan, Start, Save roll — echoing the XP Start button. Fill only; text on it is `on-go`.

tokens.name: on-go
tokens.usage: Label on a `go` fill (6.3:1 Darkroom, 5.2:1 Luna).

tokens.name: film
tokens.usage: The orange of C-41 film base. Brand accent: the film-strip edge, the scanning sweep, the roll badge, the cover. Text on it is `on-film`; never as text itself.

tokens.name: on-film
tokens.usage: Text on a `film` fill (7.9:1 Darkroom, 6.1:1 Luna).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: Warm, Booted, Frame saved. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons: lamp warming, cold scanner, dust flagged. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: USB lost, MD5 mismatch, Discard roll. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Window-level headings: the roll name above the light table, empty-state titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Window title bars only, in `on-titlebar`, with a 1px dark text shadow.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Insert the strip emulsion side down.
styles.usage: Default UI text: labels, list rows, menus, body copy in dialogs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Frame metadata, status-bar text, units. Usually in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Frame numbers, DX codes, USB IDs, hex dumps, the log console. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, caption-button gap, sprocket-hole pitch unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control inner padding, gap between frames in the strip, list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Group-box padding, toolbar gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Window content padding, dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels; empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Outer margin of the light table; cover insets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, checkboxes, chips — the XP 3px corner.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Group boxes, popovers, film frames' mount.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Top corners of a window and its title bar; bottom corners stay square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and the roll badge only.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The raised bevel on buttons and toolbar wells. Pressed state swaps to `shadow-sunken`.

tokens.name: shadow-sunken
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: the strip tray, fields, the progress trough, pressed buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: A floating window or dialog over `desktop`.
